title: DPIIT State/District FDI Equity Inflow — Consolidated Series, Oct 2019 to Mar 2026
source: DPIIT Quarterly FDI Newsletter, Table No.16 ("Statement on State/District-wise FDI Equity Inflow"), parsed directly from 24 of 26 possible quarterly PDFs. Missing: Jan-Mar 2020 and Apr-Jun 2020 (no standalone table located for either).
unit_note: inr_crore and usd_million are on a consistent basis throughout; source PDFs used both "Rs Million" (2019-2021 era, converted /10 here) and "INR Crore" (2021-2026 era) conventions, per-document, recorded in source_unit.
verification_note: Reconciled by the supplying dataset against DPIIT printed sub-totals/grand-totals per quarter (0.00-0.03% agreement claimed). Independently spot-checked by this blog against 3 overlapping quarters read directly from primary PDFs (exact match) and against 5 fiscal years of separately web-search-sourced national/state totals (matched to within rounding). See the accompanying blog post for the full verification record.
